title: Cypress
venue_description:
Reno's Premier Live Music Venue

Cypress is a vibrant music venue and restaurant located in the heart of Midtown Reno at 761 South Virginia Street. Formerly known as The Saint the venue reopened in 2022 with state-of-the-art acoustics and a modern atmosphere designed specifically for live music lovers. With a capacity of 300-400 guests Cypress creates an intimate yet energetic environment where every seat offers excellent visibility of the stage.

Music & Entertainment

The venue showcases live music across all genres including rock blues funk bluegrass indie alternative and more. Wednesday nights feature Open Spike Night hosted by Spike McGuire - a two-time winner of Reno's Best Open Mic award. This songwriting-focused open mic runs from 7-10pm and welcomes original material with house microphones available. Thursday through Saturday nights bring touring bands from across the country plus talented local musicians. The sound system is consistently praised as one of the best in Reno with professional sound engineers ensuring top-quality audio for every performance.

Food Drink & Atmosphere

Cypress offers a full bar featuring diverse craft beers on tap and expertly crafted cocktails. The restaurant menu highlights delicious wings BBQ and other crowd favorites. An outdoor patio provides additional space for guests to relax between sets. Most shows are 21+ with occasional all-ages and 18+ events. The venue operates Tuesday through Saturday with shows typically starting between 7-9pm. Pre-sale tickets often available at discounted rates through the venue website.

title: Mountain Music Parlor
venue_description:
Preserving American Heritage Music

Mountain Music Parlor is Reno's first and only Early American Music School Folk Instrument Shoppe and Listening Room all dedicated to teaching preserving and celebrating traditional American heritage music. Located at 735 South Center Street in a beautifully restored 110-year-old Arts and Crafts bungalow the venue has been an essential part of Midtown's cultural landscape since 2015. Founded by Renee and Donald Lauderback passionate advocates for grassroots music the venue embodies a mission to keep America's musical heritage alive and thriving.

Jam Sessions & Musical Community

The venue hosts eight different monthly jam sessions welcoming all ages and skill levels from absolute beginners to seasoned professionals. These include Bluegrass Jam Class Old Time Jam Celtic Sessions Cowboy Music Hawaiian Ukulele Club Dulcimer Club and Mighty Mike's Blues & Old School Country Jam. The Bluegrass Jam Class teaches traditional tunes melodies licks and break strategy in a no-judgment supportive environment. The Old Time Jam features authentic Appalachian tunes with Irish and Scottish heritage played together without breaks. Mighty Mike's Blues Jam is led by veteran bluesman Mike Schermer who has toured with legends like Bonnie Raitt Elvin Bishop and Charlie Musselwhite. A small $5 donation is requested at jams to help maintain the venue.

Instrument Shop & Heritage Hall

The folk instrument shop features high-grade new rare and vintage instruments including banjos fiddles dulcimers mandolins guitars concertinas and more - many handmade by American craftspeople. Renee travels the country seeking instruments made in barns basements and workshops ensuring authentic quality. The intimate Heritage Hall listening room hosts top-shelf award-winning artists in concerts throughout the year. The venue also offers private lessons group classes workshops and professional instrument repair services.

Monthly Open Mics

The Fourth Wednesday Songwriter Open Mic provides a welcoming platform for singer-songwriters in an intimate listening room setting. A small PA system is provided and the decent platform stage creates perfect conditions for acoustic performances. Songwriters are especially encouraged to share original material though covers are also welcome. The venue maintains a family-friendly atmosphere with plush seating and a relaxed vibe perfect for enjoying traditional American music.

title: Holland Project
venue_description:
All-Ages Community Arts Space

The Holland Project is a volunteer-driven all-ages community arts venue that has been fostering creativity and inclusivity in Reno since 2007. Located at 140 Vesta Street the project was founded by Britt Curtis inspired by Seattle's VERA Project which itself was modeled after the VERA Club in the Netherlands (Holland). The venue purchased its building through the successful Grounded campaign which raised over $600000 from private contributions allowing the community to own this vital cultural space.

Mission & Programming

The Holland Project serves as a beacon for experimentation and new ideas providing a platform for young artists alternative musicians and creative expression. With a capacity of 150 the intimate venue hosts concerts art galleries workshops craft fairs and monthly open mic nights. The all-genre all-ages open mic organized by Emma Ashley and hosted by Nimbus requires performer sign-ups through the website. Events are free for performers with a $5 door charge for audiences and proceeds often benefit local organizations like Girls Rock Reno.

Music & Arts Scene

The venue has become known for showcasing indie rock garage rock alternative punk and experimental music giving touring bands and local artists a welcoming stage. Past performers have included diverse acts across multiple genres creating an eclectic calendar of events. The space features a stage gallery library and multipurpose areas all built by dedicated volunteers who transformed the original bare building into the thriving arts hub it is today. The venue continues to evolve under new leadership while maintaining its core commitment to accessibility community building and creative exploration.

Community Impact

As one of the few all-ages venues in Reno the Holland Project plays a crucial role in providing young people access to live music and arts programming. The volunteer-driven model ensures the space remains focused on community needs rather than profit keeping ticket prices affordable and the atmosphere welcoming. The venue partners with other local organizations including KWNK community radio and various arts initiatives strengthening Reno's creative ecosystem.

title: Shim's Tavern
venue_description:
Prohibition-Style Speakeasy & Music Venue

Shim's Surplus Speakeasy is an iconic destination in downtown Reno located at 125 West 3rd Street offering a unique blend of prohibition-era atmosphere and contemporary live entertainment. The venue features moody lighting handmade stained glass discrete curtained booth spaces and a stunning sprawling marble bar creating an intimate jewel-tone lounge atmosphere. The historic building and vintage decor make it a must-visit for history enthusiasts and cocktail lovers alike.

Live Music & Open Mics

Shim's hosts nightly live entertainment across diverse genres with a strong emphasis on supporting local artists. Monday Night Poetry is the venue's flagship open mic event running every Monday since January 2022. Hosted by Reno Poet Laureate Jesse James Ziegler in collaboration with Spoken Views Collective this weekly poetry slam has grown from 5-10 attendees to filling nearly every seat and was voted Best Open Mic in Northern Nevada. Doors open at 3pm sign-ups at 5:30pm and the mic opens at 6:30pm creating a welcoming community for poets and spoken word artists. Third Thursday features both a Singer-Songwriter Open Mic and Rock Jam Session hosted by Joshua Kisor welcoming guitarists drummers and all musicians to collaborate and perform.

Entertainment Calendar

The venue features jazz musicians throughout the week creating a cozy sophisticated ambiance perfect for date nights and special occasions. Folk guitarists phenomenal magicians and other performers rotate through the schedule. Karaoke Night on Tuesdays with Kelly Proud and Friends offers another opportunity for audience participation. The venue also hosts themed parties and special events including A Very Gay Christmas and Metalesque burlesque performances.

Bar & Atmosphere

Seasoned bar staff curate time-honored cocktails using an extensive selection of spirits wine and local craft beer. The comfortable English-style booths provide intimate seating while the expansive bar area offers space to mingle. Located within walking distance of nearby casinos Shim's is perfectly positioned in the downtown entertainment district. The venue maintains a welcoming friendly atmosphere where regulars and newcomers alike feel at home. Chess games and good conversation flow freely making it a true community gathering place.

title: 10 Torr Distilling & Brewing
venue_description:
Innovative Craft Brewery & Distillery

10 Torr Distilling & Brewing is a unique craft beverage destination located at 490 Mill Street in Reno housed in a beautifully renovated 1940s-era grocery store. The venue is renowned for its revolutionary vacuum distillation technology which produces exceptionally smooth spirits by distilling at extremely low pressure and below room temperature. This innovative process preserves delicate flavors and eliminates harshness without artificial additives resulting in award-winning gin vodka whiskey and other spirits. All brewing and distilling equipment was custom designed and built in-house demonstrating the team's commitment to innovation and quality.

Taproom & Events

The modern industrial-style taproom features exposed brick barrel tables Edison bulbs and high ceilings that highlight the building's architectural character. An outdoor patio welcomes dogs and offers lawn games creating a relaxed social atmosphere. The venue hosts weekly events including Open Mic Tuesdays on the first Tuesday of each month hosted by Kat Heart. This welcoming open mic runs 6-9pm and invites performers of all experience levels to share music comedy or other talents. Trivia Wednesdays provide competitive fun while Thursday through Sunday feature comedy nights pop-up events and special themed gatherings.

Craft Beverages

The tap list features over a dozen house-brewed beers ranging from crisp Blonde Ales and refreshing Mexican lagers to robust Imperial Stouts and hazy IPAs. Popular selections include Hop Tramp IPA Secret Cove Cerveza and Fight Milk white stout with cold brew coffee. The cocktail menu showcases the house-distilled spirits in creative drinks like Lavender Lemonade Blueberry Sage Spritz Spiced Apple and the spicy Amantes Picantes. Canned cocktails are also available for purchase. Every seat at bar and tables includes purse hooks and electrical outlets for charging devices.

Food & Atmosphere

Local food trucks regularly park outside offering diverse dining options from Greek-American to BBQ and more. The venue is 21+ and offers distillery tours to showcase the unique vacuum distillation process. Weekend brunch features Mimosa Flights and Bloody Marys from noon to 5pm. Hours are Tuesday-Thursday 3-9pm Friday-Saturday noon-midnight and Sunday noon-9pm. The combination of cutting-edge brewing science exceptional hospitality and community-focused programming has made 10 Torr a standout destination in Reno's craft beverage scene.
